svg.text: Frugal-IoT Irrigation - Lolin S2 Mini wiring
Assembly view. Values, pin numbers and the reasoning are in schematic.pdf, wiring.md and README.md.
Connect probes ONE AT A TIME, in sector order.
120R across A/B at the LAST probe only.
colour is never the only cue
Shielded twisted pair to the probes:
one pair A/B, one pair 12 V/GND.
Earth the shield at the controller end only.
OUTPUT DRIVERS - five identical low-side channels
IRLZ44N: G / D / S, S -> GND
1N5819 across the load, cathode to +12 V
IRLZ44N: G / D / S, S -> GND
1N5819 across the load, cathode to +12 V
IRLZ44N: G / D / S, S -> GND
1N5819 across the load, cathode to +12 V
IRLZ44N: G / D / S, S -> GND
1N5819 across the load, cathode to +12 V
for a 12 V pump or router
IRLZ44N: G / D / S, S -> GND
1N5819 across the load, cathode to +12 V
for a 12 V pump or router
Valves must be NORMALLY CLOSED and must not be latching. Outputs are ACTIVE HIGH - most cheap opto-relay boards are active LOW. A mains pump or router goes behind an external Sonoff.
